items.title: Replace brand Lattice->Proofbound and Lattice CLI->Proofbound CLI in PROSE across README* and docs/**/*.md; keep lowercase `lattice` commands, .lattice/ paths, @lattice refs, schema-ids and salts untouched
items.context: capitalized brand word in prose is the target; lowercase identifiers/commands/paths are Phases 2-4
items.userSees: In README.md / docs the user reads "Proofbound" / "Proofbound CLI" as the product brand instead of "Lattice" / "Lattice CLI" (while `lattice` commands in code spans still show `lattice`).

happy.desc: grep README+docs: the brand phrase "Lattice CLI" is gone (now "Proofbound CLI") and capitalized prose "Lattice" → "Proofbound"

edge.desc: lowercase `lattice` commands, .lattice/ paths and @lattice refs inside docs code-spans are UNCHANGED

adversarial.desc: no schema-id / salt strings in docs were altered

items.title: Replace user-facing brand Lattice->Proofbound in packages/*/src user-visible strings (--help text, CLI banner/title, command descriptions, user-facing error messages); do NOT touch identifiers, imports, package names, .lattice paths, schema-ids, salts
items.context: only the strings a user reads; not code identifiers
items.userSees: Running the CLI --help / banner the user sees "Proofbound" in the user-facing text instead of "Lattice"; the build still compiles.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build exits 0 after the src string rebrand (no identifier touched)

edge.desc: a --help/banner string now reads Proofbound; grep confirms user-facing brand strings changed

adversarial.desc: no TypeScript identifier/type name was changed (tsc passes), only string literals/comments

items.title: Update package.json description fields to Proofbound (NOT the name field)
items.context: description only; name/@lattice stay for Phase 2
items.userSees: package.json description fields read "Proofbound" (the npm "name" field stays @lattice/lattice for Phase 2).

happy.desc: grep package.json description fields → Proofbound (not Lattice)

items.title: Build + full test suite green; verify NO change to the lattice binary name, @lattice/* package names, .lattice/ paths, lattice.*.v1 schema-ids, or lattice-* salts (grep-confirm they are unchanged)
items.context: Phase 1 must not touch any load-bearing identifier
items.userSees: The terminal prints the test suite passing and exits 0 (e.g. "npm test" → exit 0), and `git grep -c "@lattice/"` plus the `.lattice/`-path / `lattice.*.v1` / `lattice-*` salt counts are IDENTICAL to main (identifiers byte-unchanged).

edge.desc: git grep confirms the lattice binary name, @lattice/* package names, .lattice/ paths are byte-unchanged vs main

adversarial.desc: git grep confirms the 122 lattice.*.v1 schema-ids and 15 lattice-* salts are unchanged vs main

items.title: Add a CHANGELOG entry documenting the Phase-1 user-visible Lattice->Proofbound rebrand and that internal identifiers are deferred to later phases
items.userSees: In `git diff CHANGELOG.md` the user sees an added entry: "Phase 1 of the Lattice→Proofbound rebrand — user-visible brand only (docs/--help/descriptions); internal identifiers (lattice binary, @lattice packages, .lattice dir, schema-ids, salts) deferred to later phases."

happy.desc: git diff shows a CHANGELOG entry describing the Phase-1 Lattice→Proofbound user-visible rebrand

edge.desc: the entry states internal identifiers (binary/packages/.lattice/schema-ids/salts) are deferred

adversarial.desc: grep -c the Experiments/Changed heading is not duplicated
